title: From Build, Demo to GTM: Jax Koh x AdaL
summary: We’ve been on a roll with events lately, and Monday night was no exception! We hosted Jax, a GTM engineer, for an exclusive AdaL workshop at the Curtin Entrepreneurs Hub.
description: Perth AI operates across three core streams—Builders & Startups, Product & Eng, and AI-First Enterprise—and this event was tailor-made for our Builders & Startups stream. It certainly didnt disappoint, drawing a fantastic crowd of 65+ people eager to learn and build together.
imageAlt: Attendees at the Jax Koh and AdaL workshop beside a Perth AI banner.
artworkAlt: From Build, Demo to GTM event artwork featuring Jax Koh and AdaL.

sections.title: 1. The Fireside Chat
paragraphs: Kicking things off,
did an incredible job MCing a conversation exploring
inspiring journey:
items: 🔹 Growing up in Malaysia and studying computer science at UQ.
🔹 Landing a dream role at an AI agent startup in San Francisco.
🔹 Leading UQ students on visits to exclusive big tech companies in Silicon Valley.
🔹 Discussing what makes the SF tech scene so uniquely vibrant.

sections.title: 2. Hands-On Building with AdaL
paragraphs: The second session was what everyone was waiting for: building! Huge thanks to Jax for providing all the credits. Attendees jumped right in, getting the CLI up and running in no time.
AdaL is an automation-first agent harness that shines at browser use, system integrations, and tool execution—making it a powerhouse for tasks like running GTM campaigns.

sections.title: 3. World-First AI Video Generation
paragraphs: The Perth AI community got an exclusive first look at AdaL’s brand-new video generation feature, launched just a day prior. Attendees immediately put it to the test, generating:
items: 🔹 A Perth AI promo video featuring a hip-hop-dancing, bug-smashing quokka
🔹 A Welcome to Perth message from
🔹 A winning GTM video for a shopping site by
, who walked away with a Chokka Quokka for his efforts!

paragraphs: Jax & AdaL: Thank you for the pizzas, and for traveling thousands of kilometers to give Perth a world-first look at the video generation tool as the very first stop on your global GTM tour!

title: Perth AI at DDD Perth 2026
summary: What an incredible day at DDD Perth 2026! 🚀
description: The Perth AI booth was buzzing from start to finish, and we loved connecting with everyone who stopped by to learn more about our community. Thank you for the wonderful conversations, fantastic feedback, and incredible energy!
imageAlt: The Perth AI team and attendees gathered at the DDD Perth booth.
artworkAlt: Perth AI at DDD Perth booth artwork with a quokka and event activities.

sections.title: Highlights from the Day:
paragraphs: The Quokka Run Game: Absolute crowd-pleaser! It definitely brought out some fierce (and fun) competitive streaks. 🏃💨

Swag and Prizes: Congrats to our main stage JB Hi-Fi gift voucher winner, our "trip for 2 to Rotto" quokka runner prize winners, and everyone who scored a Quokka Chokka! We hope you love them (and thank you for the great feedback on our quokka mascot and logo).
Inspirational Talks: A huge highlight was
' amazing keynote on agents doing what they’ve been tasked to do.

title: Matt Pocock Skills Workshop
summary: A workshop on modern development skills and agentic tooling for Curtin University students and postgraduates.
description: A small-group session on software engineering with agentic tools, including skills, plug-ins and practical tips.
